standard_prerequisites.use: Upper semicontinuity input for fibre dimension (Morphisms, lemma-openness-bounded-dimension-fibres) and the proper cohomology finiteness plus base-change theorems (Limits, lemmas proper-top-cohomology-finite-type, higher-direct-images-zero-above-dimension-fibre).

core_obligations: Shrink to an affine base controlling fibre dimension.
Use finite generation and base-change of R^1 to convert the hypothesis to a module statement.

proof_roadmap.step: Finite generation of R^1 turns the pointwise vanishing into Nakayama.
Principal open kills the module universally.

difficulty_reason: For a proper morphism f : X -> Y and a point y whose fibre has dimension at most 1 and H^1 of the structure sheaf zero, the lemma produces an open neighbourhood V of y with R^1 f_* O_X vanishing on V and still vanishing after any base change of V. The retained proof is complete: reduce to Y affine and all fibres of dimension at most 1 using openness of bounded fibre dimension (Morphisms, lemma-openness-bounded-dimension-fibres); invoke finite generation and base-change compatibility of R^1 for proper maps (Limits, lemmas proper-top-cohomology-finite-type and higher-direct-images-zero-above-dimension-fibre); translate the fibre vanishing into pM_p = M_p for the finite module M on Y = Spec A, kill M_p by Nakayama, and take a principal open where M vanishes. Retained author proof at lines 20951-20968.

dedup.scope: Neighbourhood spreading of a single-fibre H^1 vanishing for proper maps.
